title: How to Evaluate Sources for Reliability — Writing for Kids
skills: evaluate whether a source is reliable
identify indicators of credible and questionable information
compare sources for accuracy, authority, and relevance
select trustworthy evidence for research and academic writing
alignment_note: Provides an accessible introduction to evaluating sources for reliability by examining credibility, accuracy, authority, and relevance. Although designed for younger learners, it can serve as foundational review, intervention, or reinforcement of research and information-literacy skills across high school English courses.
